# Vendor extensions index

Vendor extensions are useful for NEATO developers and OS developers because it allows for extra functionality that might not be defined in NEATO itself.

For example, in real computers there's graphics APIs that might be common between OSes (OpenGL, Vulkan) while others might not be. (Metal, DirectX)

So, standards can be made for basically any kind of interface, and NEATO devs can easily check for if they are available.

Third-party standards are found in this directory. Contributions are open to anyone via Pull Request.

# List

*Currently as of this moment, there are no documented vendor extensions in this repo.*
